headline: Man United-linked Dominic Calvert-Lewin signs new Leeds contract
description: Leeds United have announced striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin has signed a new two-and-a-half-year contract with the club.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barça, Madrid jockey for position in Erling Haaland chase
description: Barcelona and Real Madrid are positioning themselves for a move for Man City striker Erling Haaland. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Hislop: Next games a 'barometer' in Man United relegation battle
description: Shaka Hislop and Steve Nicol question whether Manchester United are at risk of relegation from the Premier League.

headline: Liverpool captain Virgil Van Dijk lauds 'outstanding striker' Alexander Isak
description: Liverpool Virgil van Dijk is expecting "fireworks" during Sunday's Merseyside derby and praised the impact of Alexander Isak and Florain Wirtz.

headline: Xabi Alonso: Wesley Fofana interview row 'closed' after apology
description: Xabi Alonso called the matter "closed" after Wesley Fofana appeared to joke about Chelsea's Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool during an unauthorised interview.

headline: Omar Marmoush hails Luca Williams-Barnett as 'unbelievable' after full Spurs debut
description: Omar Marmoush has hailed Luca Williams-Barnett as "unbelievable" and believes the teen sensation has a "very promising future ahead of him."
